title: Loveholic
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Nishioka, a 27-year-old, independent and reckless photographer, keeps clashing with Matsukawa, a successful advertising supervisor, yet their joint projects are always hits. Beneath the bickering lies a deep attraction, complicated by the past and, per MangaUpdates, a dead former lover. A two-volume adult boys' love drama.
life_message: Letting go of pride and past grief makes room for a committed, honest love.
